solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Spring tax returns for Picasso?

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring

indicators.note: returns says the word for tax is read backwards

parts.note: to drain is to tax or exhaust

explanation.surface: A painter's springtime tax return is being filed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returns' looks like part of a tax return, but it is the signal to read the word for tax backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Picasso was born in Málaga, so he is an example of a man from Spain; the question mark flags the example.

clue.text: Climbing southern mountains with husband in plaster

indicators.note: in a down clue climbing means the letters are read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: the Alps are mountains

explanation.surface: A climber goes up southern peaks with her husband in a plaster cast.
explanation.definitionFit: To plaster something is to daub or spatter it thickly, as one does with paint or mud.

clue.text: Star of panto was leaving wings with resolution

indicators.note: losing their wings, panto and was each drop the first and last letters

parts.note: res is the short form of resolution, as in high-res images

explanation.surface: The pantomime's lead performer stepped away from the wings, determined.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Star' and 'wings' suggest theatre; wings are the outer letters of PANTO and WAS.
explanation.definitionFit: Antares is the bright red giant at the heart of the Scorpius constellation.

clue.text: Weakness of urban housing control

indicators.note: housing means the phrase for urban holds the other piece inside

parts.note: urban means in a city
a cap is a limit or control, as on spending

explanation.surface: A frailty in the way city accommodation is regulated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'housing' suggests homes, but it is the containment signal: urban is read as the phrase 'in a city'.
explanation.definitionFit: Incapacity is a lack of ability or strength, a state of being unable, hence weakness.

clue.text: Deplorable fellow stops fermenting Pilsner beer

indicators.note: stops means the fellow plugs a gap, sitting inside the churned letters
fermenting beer is bubbling and working, so the letters churn

parts.note: he is a male, a fellow

explanation.surface: A disgraceful man halts the brewing of lager.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fermenting' reworks PILSNER BEER into REPRENSIBLE, and 'stops' plugs HE into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reprehensible deserves blame or censure, so it is shameful and deplorable.

clue.text: Reproductive organ of fish feels oddly deficient

parts.note: the carp is a freshwater fish

indicators.note: lacking its odd letters, the word feels keeps only its second and fourth

explanation.surface: Something about a fish's reproductive organ seems strangely lacking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly deficient' drops the 1st, 3rd and 5th letters of FEELS, leaving EL.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpel is the female seed-bearing part of a flower, a botanical reproductive structure.

clue.text: Too early? Stop regularly

indicators.note: regularly picks the even letters in turn from early and stop

explanation.surface: Is it too soon? Halt at intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: Also and too both mean in addition, as in 'me too'.

clue.text: Buccaneer less angry aboard working barge

indicators.note: less says the word for angry is taken away

parts.note: a buccaneer is a pirate
irate means angry
onto means aboard, on to a vessel
on means working, functioning

explanation.surface: A pirate, calmer now, is on board a working barge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'less' strips IRATE from PIRATE to leave P.
explanation.definitionFit: A pontoon is a flat-bottomed boat, the kind used as a lighter or ferry.

clue.text: Albatross heard above head of superstitious sailor and his guide

indicators.note: in a down clue above puts this piece on top of the next
heard says the word for burden is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: an albatross round one's neck is a burden, a load

indicators.note: the head of superstitious is its first letter

parts.note: tar is a sailor

explanation.surface: The Ancient Mariner's albatross, superstitious sailors, and the guiding star.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface recalls Coleridge's Ancient Mariner, who shot an albatross; 'heard' gives LODE for LOAD.
explanation.definitionFit: A lodestar is a star steered by, especially the Pole Star, so figuratively a guiding principle.

clue.text: Small ducks ruined patch of ground

indicators.note: to duck is to dodge or get out of, so the small letter escapes from the word

parts.note: lost, as in a lost cause, means ruined
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels

explanation.surface: Little ducks have wrecked a plot of land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ducks' looks like birds but is a verb: S ducks out of LOST.
explanation.definitionFit: A lot is a parcel or plot of land, as in a parking lot or building lot.

clue.text: Splendidly accoutred drunk embracing mean one thus

indicators.note: embracing says the word for drunk wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: caned is British slang for very drunk
par is the average or mean level
I is the Roman numeral one
so means thus, in this way

explanation.surface: A finely dressed drunk is hugging an average person in this way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'embracing' is the containment signal; caned is British slang for very drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: Caparisoned describes a horse decked out in ornamental trappings, hence richly decked out.

clue.text: Criminal charge for tough guys in court is getting closer

parts.note: a rap is a criminal charge, as in 'beat the rap'
pro means for, in favour of

indicators.note: in puts the tough guys inside the abbreviation for court

parts.note: he-men are macho tough guys

explanation.surface: A criminal charge for gangsters in court is drawing near.
explanation.definitionFit: A rapprochement is a re-establishment of friendly relations, a coming together of parties.

clue.text: Ultimately frantic perhaps as jockeys refuse to go on these

indicators.note: to jockey is to manoeuvre about, so these letters are shifted into a new order
ultimately points to the final letter of frantic

explanation.surface: Racing jockeys are frantically refusing to ride on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jockeys' looks like riders and 'refuse' like a verb; 'jockeys' rearranges C+PERHAPS+AS, and 'refuse' is rubbish, the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish is dumped on heaps of scrap, so they are where refuse goes.

clue.text: Master mariner wearing breeches inside out

indicators.note: the sailor has the outer pair on round him, so the seaman sits inside them
with its inside gone, only the outer letters of breeches are left

parts.note: OS is an ordinary seaman

explanation.surface: A ship's captain has put his breeches on inside out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside out' leaves B and S from BREECHES; 'wearing' puts OS between them.
explanation.definitionFit: A boss is the person in charge, a synonym for one's master or employer.

clue.text: Supply insane sum to retain a literary assistant

indicators.note: to retain means the shuffled letters keep the a inside them
read as supply, the adverb from supple, this signals a flexible rearrangement

explanation.surface: Provide a crazy amount of money to keep someone on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Supply' reads as a verb but is supple-ly, bending INSANE SUM, which then keeps A inside.
explanation.definitionFit: An amanuensis is a person who takes dictation or copies manuscripts for a writer.

clue.text: Leaders of party salute your revolutionary spirit

indicators.note: leaders are the front letters of party, salute and your

parts.note: Che Guevara was the Argentine-born revolutionary

explanation.surface: Party bosses hail your revolutionary fervour.
explanation.definitionFit: The psyche is the soul or mind, the human spirit in Greek thought.

clue.text: Drop unbounded passion for EU nation

indicators.note: with no bounds, the word drop loses its first and last letters

parts.note: a mania is a passion or craze

explanation.surface: Give up your boundless enthusiasm for a European country.
explanation.definitionFit: Romania joined the European Union in 2007, so it is a member state.

clue.text: Refuse to sanction pallid policeman at first

indicators.note: at first puts the policeman ahead of the pallid piece

parts.note: DI is a detective inspector
sallow means pale and pallid

explanation.surface: Turn down permission for the pale officer at first.
explanation.definitionFit: To disallow is to reject or rule out, so to decline approval, as with a goal.

clue.text: One's favourite American drive

parts.note: one is means I am, contracted to I'm
a pet is a favourite
US stands for United States, so American

explanation.surface: Someone declares their preferred American road trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drive' looks like a car outing; it is motivation.
explanation.definitionFit: Impetus is the force or momentum that pushes something on, a synonym of drive.

clue.text: Flamboyant style long crushed by censure

indicators.note: in a down clue the yearning piece sits under the criticism, pressed below it

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly
to ache is to long or yearn

explanation.surface: A showy flair long squashed by criticism.
explanation.walkthrough: 'long' is a verb here, to yearn, not an adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Panache is dash and verve, a confident flair in manner.

clue.text: Without a pair of spectacles, kiss and cuddle something wicked!

indicators.note: without says the letters for the spectacles are taken out

parts.note: to canoodle is to kiss and cuddle
two O shapes look like the round lenses of glasses

explanation.surface: Taking your glasses off for a smooch is rather naughty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' removes the two Os from CANOODLE; in cricket a pair of spectacles is two ducks, scores of nought.
explanation.definitionFit: A candle has a wick, so it is jokingly something 'wick-ed'.

clue.text: Delay arresting university doctor over complaint

indicators.note: arresting means the delay catches and holds the other pieces

parts.note: a lag is a delay
MB is a Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor
O is the cricket scorers' abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A delay in detaining a university medic over a grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: Complaint means an ailment, and this one is pain in the lower back.

clue.text: Third of troopers, say, retreat, upset and nervous

indicators.note: the third letter of troopers
in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: eg, for example, means say
a den is a private retreat

explanation.surface: One soldier in three, for instance, falls back, distressed and jittery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks emotional, but in a down clue it turns the two pieces upside down, giving NEDGE.
explanation.definitionFit: To be on edge is to be tense, jumpy and anxious.

clue.text: Complaint coming from Isaac Newton

indicators.note: coming from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A grievance originating with the great physicist.
explanation.definitionFit: Complaint can mean an ailment or disorder, and this skin condition is one.

clue.text: Jumping beans, a meal for Jack

indicators.note: jumping beans leap about, so the letters of beans and meal bounce into a new order

explanation.surface: Mexican jumping beans make a supper for a man called Jack.
explanation.walkthrough: Jack, or jack tar, is a sailor in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Jack is a traditional name for a sailor, and this is a seaman's rank.

clue.text: Belch while keeling over

indicators.note: keeling over means toppling, so in this down clue the word is upended

parts.note: a while is a time

explanation.surface: Burping while falling over.
explanation.definitionFit: To belch is to send out smoke or gas forcefully, to discharge it.

clue.text: Treated Uncle Tom, being doctor

indicators.note: treated means processed or worked on, so the letters are reworked

parts.note: ens is Latin for a being or entity

explanation.surface: Uncle Tom was treated while he was a doctor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Treated' looks medical but rearranges UNCLE TOM into LOCUMTEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in doctor covering for another is called by this Latin phrase meaning one holding the place.

clue.text: Join old man, heading some way back

indicators.note: the head letter of the word for old man is moved further back

parts.note: dad is one's father, the old man

explanation.surface: Join your father as he makes his way home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading some way back' moves the first D of DAD to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: To add is to attach or append, a synonym of join.

clue.text: Fury engulfing English crown

indicators.note: engulfing says the word for fury swallows the letter

parts.note: wrath is fury

explanation.surface: Outrage overwhelms the English monarchy.
explanation.definitionFit: A garland or circlet of flowers worn on the head serves as a crown, as for a victor.

clue.text: Lug instrument and books round room

parts.note: OT is the Old Testament, a set of books
O is round in shape
scope is room, space to act

explanation.surface: A tool for hauling, with books, round a room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lug' looks like a verb, to haul; it is slang for the ear.
explanation.definitionFit: Lug is slang for the ear, and this device is used by doctors to look into ears.
